Update a playlist image. Use this tool to update a playlist image.

Usage:
  yutu playlistImage update [flags]

Examples:
# Update a playlist image
yutu playlistImage update --playlistId PLxxx --type hero --width 2048 --height 1152

Flags:
  -H, --height int                             The image height
  -h, --help                                   help for update
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
  -p, --playlistId string                      ID of the playlist this image is associated with
  -t, --type string                            The image type (e.g., 'hero')
  -W, --width int                              The image width
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
